title: Equivalence of Worst-Case and Average-Case Hardness for NP (Excluding Heuristica)
exact_target: Does strong worst-case hardness in NP necessarily create an efficiently distributed NP problem that is hard on average?

sources.citation: A. Bogdanov, L. Trevisan, SIAM J. Comput. 36(4):1119-1159, 2006.
